ana: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a small watchdog and activation-fencing addition to on-prem airgap apply flow. Want quick sanity-check.

kevin: Short problem statement?

ana: Two failures in staging: large delta apply stalls leaving partial files; and activation happening during transient partition. Need deterministic recovery and clear operator signals.

sarah: Suggest a light state machine: APPLY -> WATCHDOG -> STAGED -> RECONCILE -> ACTIVATE. WATCHDOG enforces checkpoints and can move to QUARANTINE or AUTO_ROLLBACK (config).

kevin: Define checkpoint: signed record per component or per N bytes: {manifest,component,offset,checksum,timestamp} written to /var/lib/redwood/apply-checkpoints.log. If missing X times transition.

ana: Defaults: checkpoint_interval_bytes=64MB, watchdog_miss_threshold=3, check_interval_ms=5000. Bundle header may override.

verifier-bot: policy: checkpoint entries must be signed by agent; signature failure -> QUARANTINE (no apply).

kevin: Resume semantics important: writers must support idempotent resume (verify already-written offsets). Use staging dir /var/lib/redwood/staged/<bundle>/parts and .marker files per-part.

sarah: Activation-fencing: require activation_lease with monotonic lease_epoch. Activation step must acquire lease; implement as atomic write+fsync+rename on /var/lib/redwood/activation-lease. If mismatch refuse to activate.

ana: Operator UX: console shows reason, last checkpoint, and one-click actions: rollback-to-last-success or force-resume (typed confirm). Also require pager on lease corruption or verifier failures; timeouts are warnings.

kevin: CLI snippets for runbook: 
redwood-agent checkpoints --bundle B --tail 50
redwood-agent rollback --to-last-success --confirm
redwood-agent resume --bundle B --force

sarah: Defaults conservative: auto_rollback=false. Add flag watchdog-dry-run for staging to simulate transitions without changing state.

ana: Telemetry to emit: watchdog_tripped_count, last_checkpoint_offset, activation_lease_epoch, verifier_failures.

ops-bot: apply job 4161234567 status=watchdog:event=checkpoint_ok offset=67108864

ana: I'll update the RFC with state machine diagram, checkpoint format, knobs, lease spec, and runbook. Merge later today if no objections.
